title: API Gateway Rate Limiting
description: Add rate limiting to API gateway: define limits, deploy, test, tune for optimal throughput

steps.description: Analyze current traffic patterns: peak TPS, 99th percentile burst, client distribution by API key
Set rate limits per route and per client (standard: 1000 req/s per route, 100 req/s per key)
Apply rate limiting rules via Terraform to API Gateway usage plans and WAF rate-based rules
Deploy to canary stage first; verify legitimate traffic passes and throttled clients get 429 correctly
Run load test at 80%, 100%, and 120% of defined limits; confirm throttling behavior
Adjust limits based on load test results and false-positive 429 rate; retest
Promote rate limiting to production stage with monitoring dashboards and alarms
